description.zh: 翻译的证件类型：身份证(idcard)，驾驶证(driving_license)
description.en: Type of certificate to translate: ID card (idcard), driver's license (driving_license)

description.zh: oss文件地址：一个可以不用赋权就能访问的HTTP地址
description.en: OSS file URL: an HTTP URL that can be accessed without authorization

description.zh: 翻译结果类型：文本（text），图片（image），不传值默认：text
description.en: Result Type: text or image. If no value is provided, the default is text.

descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解图片翻译产品的[收费方式和价格](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163332.html)。

该接口适用于**证件翻译**。 如需调用通用图片翻译和电商图片翻译，请参考[图片翻译调用指南](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2505940.html)。



**图片限制**
文件大小限制：4M
支持的格式：jpg, jpeg, png

接口QPS限制：40

> 仅支持通过POST方式调用
descriptions.en:
Before using this API, make sure you fully understand the [pricing and billing method](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163332.html) of the Image Translation product.

This API is designed for **certificate translation**. For general image translation or e-commerce image translation, refer to the [Image Translation API Guide](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2505940.html).



**Image Requirements**  
File Size limit: 4 MB  
Supported formats: jpg, jpeg, png  

API queries per second (QPS) limit: 40  

> This API supports invocation only via POST requests.
